title: Slime Siege Runner
heading: Slime Siege
help: Pick a step and click Green flag. Drag a cannon from the shop (bottom left) anywhere on the meadow; pick a tool, then click a cannon.

1.name: Slimes
1.note: Clones head for the keep: point towards, then turn by a wave.

2.name: Towers
2.note: Click the shop and drag: follow the mouse until you let go.

3.name: Aiming
3.note: The cannon scans; its long beam costume finds slimes with touching.

4.name: Shooting
4.note: Bolts are clones of their cannon; touching the bolt colour hurts slimes.

5.name: Chewing and repair
5.note: Slimes chew cannons in their way; Repair mends them.

6.name: Upgrades
6.note: Speed, Damage, Pierce, Strength: each cannon keeps its own.

7.name: Waves
7.note: Tougher, faster slimes from more sides; a boss every fifth wave. The whole game.
